decisions.reason: Increasing the reader view width does not change NFT-holder eligibility, Lit Protocol gating, ownership checks, or network configuration.
The reader-width change does not alter IPFS storage, Pinata, or the ebook take-down option.
The source does not change email delivery or the contents and links required in transactional emails.
The requested width increase applies to the book reader view, not the landing-page content or layout.
The source does not revise any FAQ topic or approved FAQ copy.
The book-reader width adjustment does not change the About-page content or prize-mechanics copy.
Book-reader width is independent of the landing-page cover's size, placement, and cropping.
The reader-width change does not alter email authentication or dashboard-access behavior.
Changing the book view width does not affect which book access, referral identity, badges, or tickets follow an NFT transfer.
The reader presentation change does not alter the NFT ebook asset format or unlimited edition supply.
The source does not change referral-code identity, persistence, or display locations.
The reader-width request does not change no-referral commission allocation; the source's minting discussion reports problems rather than establishing a new allocation rule.
